title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Mantra restructures after OM token collapse and tough year
summary: RWA blockchain Mantra is restructuring and cutting staff after an OM token collapse and prolonged market pressure strained its business model in 2025.

title: Crossmint gets MiCA nod to provide stablecoin infrastructure across EU
summary: Crossmint has secured MiCA authorization from Spain’s CNMV to operate as a crypto asset service provider, allowing it to passport stablecoin infrastructure services across the EU.

title: Bitcoin ETFs on rollercoaster as traditional funds pull in $46B in 2026
summary: Bitcoin ETF flows have swung sharply in early 2026 as investors pour billions into traditional ETFs, leaving crypto funds lagging behind.

title: Germany’s DZ Bank secures MiCA license for ‘meinKrypto’ platform
summary: Retail crypto access will initially cover Bitcoin, Ether, Litecoin and Cardano through participating cooperative banks.

title: Tokenized gold accounts for 25% of RWA net growth in 2025 after 177% market-cap rise
summary: Onchain gold products added billions in new value last year, outpacing physical bullion and most gold ETFs as trading activity increasingly shifted to blockchain rails.

title: Spain’s Bankinter joins $35M Bit2Me round amid growing bank crypto alliances
summary: Bankinter joins Tether and BBVA in the $35 million investment round after the Spanish crypto exchange received its MiCA license in 2025.

title: Perp DEXs will ‘eat’ expensive TradFi in 2026: Delphi Digital
summary: Perp DEXs handle only a fraction of the trading activity seen in TradFi investments, but their infrastructure is catching up to the slow and fragmented centralized trading venues.

title: Backpack exchange launches beta testing of prediction market platform
summary: Backpack exchange launched an invite-only beta for its Unified Prediction Portfolio, letting users hedge and trade across markets in a single crypto account.

title: Visa taps BVNK to power stablecoin payouts on Visa Direct
summary: Visa has chosen BVNK to power Visa Direct pilots using stablecoins, enabling pre-funded cross-border payouts to wallets in select markets.
